note: Primitive DNR state forest campground along the west shore of Larson Lake, a designated trout lake, southeast of Effie. Sites are a cleared area with fire ring and table. --Claude
summary: DNR re-read: 12 sites (1 accessible), vault toilets, well water, $17 tax-included, same-day online payment (the old 'paid at the campground' was wrong; no envelopes on site). Manager Scenic State Park 218-571-2600. Stored lakefront is not supported: its evidence describes the day-use shelter/fishing-pier clearing, and the campsite spurs to the north end 15-25 m from shore behind a tree fringe. Recommend lakeview. Website to hyphen form. Pin ~220 m off: move to the DNR point.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview (stored value is not --AWH): the stored evidence ('campsite clearing (vault toilet) with an open tan/grass apron running unobstructed ~40m to the dock/shoreline' at 47.7646,-93.4188) is, on the 110 m frame, a day-use clearing with a large shelter-sized building and a fishing pier, not a camp spur. The campground road runs north along the west shore (47.7660-47.7685, -93.4170 to -93.4185); its short spurs end about 15-25 m from the water behind a continuous tree fringe (e.g. clearing about 47.7669,-93.4179; spur end about 47.7680,-93.4170). DNR gives no site map or per-site photos, so no site can be named with open ground to the shore. Default down.
PIN MOVE (~220 m): stored 47.76410,-93.42000 is in the woods south-west of the day-use clearing. DNR facility point 47.765902,-93.418718 sits on the campground road among the spurs. Move there.
PHONE: none stored; manager 'Scenic State Park' 218-571-2600 (DNR facility record).

NOTE correction: old note said 'Pay on site' and 'drive-in plus some hike-in/walk-in sites'; DNR says fees are paid online the same day and 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site'; the DNR record does not mention walk-in sites, so that clause is dropped.
ACCESS alert (no effect on the campground): DNR sft00021 alert 'South Lofgren Road - Closed due to flooding'.
